After I confirmed "Delete permanently," the bookmark left the library and I got a clear "Bookmark deleted" confirmation, so I know the action went through and it's really gone rather than being left wondering. Deletion feels right: deliberate to start, a clear warning of exactly what I'd lose with a way to back out, and a plain confirmation once it's done. Happy with delete.

I'll look forward to seeing that gentler Archive option next — the "set it aside but keep everything" one.
